description:
MCP wire layer on top of the official Java SDK
        (io.modelcontextprotocol.sdk:mcp). Spawns MCP servers over stdio —
        a container or a local process — and provides tools/list and
        tools/call. Streamable HTTP is not implemented yet. Stateless, no
        user sessions, no credential resolution: the caller brings
        ready-made connection parameters. Value types live in
        mc-mcp-gateway-core.
